# Normalize with Highest Den Term

![Normalize with Highest Den Term function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/polynomial/normalize_high.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Normalize with Highest Den Term. Divides both polynomials by the highest nonzero denominator coefficient. Coefficients are ascending powers. DBL/CDB promotion is explicit; input arrays are immutable. Empty coefficient vectors are errors unless explicitly documented.

Divise les deux polynômes par le coefficient non nul du dénominateur de plus haute puissance. Les coefficients suivent les puissances croissantes. La promotion DBL/CDB est explicite ; les tableaux d’entrée restent immuables. Les vecteurs de coefficients vides sont des erreurs, sauf indication explicite.

## Types and connection rules

Normalize with Highest Den Term. Divides both polynomials by the highest nonzero denominator coefficient. Coefficients are ascending powers. DBL/CDB promotion is explicit; input arrays are immutable. Empty coefficient vectors are errors unless explicitly documented.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.polynomial.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: permitted by this profile.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.
- Shape rule: `polynomial_declared_rank_and_point_shape`.
- Scalar lifting: no.
- Broadcasting: no.

**Input count:** 2; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `numerator` → `denominator`.
